highlights: The user guide is redesigned, with new pictures, an In short box on every chapter and menu paths as chips
25 guide pictures are re-taken on the current version and the home page demo clips are re-recorded
The Voxel Resolution slider can be dragged onto a shelf in Customize Shelves and stays there (#191)
Big Clay strokes leave one even band, not a row of rings, and symmetry near the mirror plane matches (#196)
Proof mode runs the standard strokes on a 104 million triangle head, and the Performance guide shows measured times
